content: ओजस् {%n.%} .²1 Bodily strength, vigour; energy, ability. .²2 Vitality; <ls>Ms. 1. 16</ls>. .²3 Virility, the generative faculty. The writers on Āyurveda, however, disstinguish between ओजस् and शुकम्; <ab>cf.</ab> क्षीरस्थघृतमिव भिन्नमोजः शुकेण Ḍalhaṇa. रसादीनां शुकान्तानां धातूनां यत् परं तेजस्तत् खलु ओजः Sruśr. ओजोविवृद्धौ देहस्य तुष्टि-पुष्टिबलोदयाः Aṣṭāṅga. .²4 Splendour, light; <ls>Bhāg. 7. 3. 23</ls>. .²5 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) An elaborate form of style, abundance of compounds; (considered by Daṇḍin to be the ‘soul of prose’); ओजः समासभूयस्त्वमेतद्गद्यस्य जीवितम् <ls>Kāv. 1. 80</ls>; see <ls>K. P. 8</ls> also; said to be of 5 kinds in <ls>R. G.</ls> .²6 (In <ab>Astr.</ab>) Each alternate sign of the zodiac (as the first, third <ab>&c.</ab>). .²7 Water. .²8 Metallic lustre. .²9 Manifestation, appearance. .²10 Skill in the use of weapons. .²11 Speed; एष ह्यतिबलः सैन्ये रथेन पवनौजसा <ls>Rām. 7. 29. 12</ls>.
